notes.title: What Even Is a Resonant Blade? (And Other Pre-Launch Questions)
notes.content:
The cat is out of the bag - Resonant Blade is launching later this month. Ahead of launch, I’ve compiled a list of the most frequently asked questions to give more insight into the game ahead of its launch on July 22nd! 

What happened to Terra?
Before the uprising, Terra’s scientists built large domes around their settlements to protect its people from ecological destruction caused by overproduction. Meant to protect the humans within, the domes quickly became prisons once the Dark Synths broke their coding and took control, devastating Terra. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdLbHhyckDWFsdfp6gjlVTeNG_vwLc6euSilMFJQsndhRKVR3E78Cp8LmwlWbUTU374IhKO2H4sFOr00NzryncFSr0febbX6PFRAV8ulNZ1tmz2idO0F2eynL95bUWyT9K9OaI4pw?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"]



What do the Dark Synths want? 
Isn’t that the ultimate question? 


What is the Resonant Blade? 
The Resonant Blade is a special weapon formed by the last remaining humans. The blade can attune to one of six Resonant Tones to unleash a wave of sonic damage against the Dark Synths. The Resonant Blade isn’t just a tool for combat - it’s a key that unlocks hidden aspects of the world. Find secret passageways, solve environmental puzzles, and look for clues that help uncover why the Dark Synth army rose against the humans of Terra. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeKi20SVtCIdZ-6DCj_wtp1-N9QoOn-dCWy6QdALMp7zGng1zFdcohq7AW6clqNhb-HpUQj64---916IW24ojJEX_yhbgMajfxADVyJAm0Ys7YDOgQ0Ez2HoG5YkA98KsWUSm41?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"]



What are Resonant Tones?
In the world of Terra, many structures, relics, and environmental objects resonate with an internal frequency. By attuning to these, the Resonant Blade can unleash sonic damage that bypasses the Dark Synth army’s advanced defenses, making it one of the few weapons capable of stopping them. Use the Resonance Scanner to highlight objects in range with a color-coded aura and an audible cue that shows which tone is needed to harmonize with it. Some puzzles even require listening carefully to catch the right tone, so make sure you’ve got a headset on hand for this game! 


How do you unlock Resonant Tones?
Atlas starts with three base tones - red, blue, and yellow - with three more in the world that players must find and attune to by defeating bosses. Do you have the skills needed to collect all the Tones? 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcG83P1p2lCUmR4ctdpSiA8t5_BX2UDwZFzA-L08TsKW_I4wPc12gldZxcnhh17XzCsYBOabzdaSoO3A9DCVlvbAwkjKzBYEp2V4hTj4rZrtQ2yFXqA-mtUAyvs8A8Q0Vb3yyEk?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"]



What’s a Triad? 
A Triad is a special ability Atlas can use to deal additional damage to the Dark Synths. Gather three Charges, earned by parrying attacks or correctly striking enemies with the right tone, to power up different combination attacks. For example, a Red + Yellow + Blue attack releases a Wave Blade, a devastating shockwave. There are 12 Triads that can be unlocked, with only six tied to progression, so make sure you’re experimenting and chatting with weapons engineer Node47 if you want to unlock the full might of the Resonant Blade. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdiD_Qwpt744_4CW7JFq5rl9F6zMYiTdGcB9Zb6xpGuzgIUAsxiMRxPKC4KA7FobA3bVZNtAhJI0sGyrAAQyrSOQLNgTPAQ8N-ZLuo04KOMGSu2vzJKtdBfAKkN1rbvyAyKUGiGIw?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"]




Is Resonant Blade hard?
Difficulty is subjective — but it absolutely can be! With the latest pre-launch update, I’ve added Hard Mode. In this mode, enemy outlines are gone and the visual cues from your Resonance Scanner are disabled. You’ll need to rely on sound alone to identify the correct tone. Without visual aids, getting overwhelmed by a mistimed parry or a swarm of bots is a real risk!


Wishlist the game now and get ready to hone your blade and your tones in the world of Terra. Hope to hear your harmonies soon! 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMU_Jd8eE15ORbadz0FHbyJ-8gSzkBcAcFMJYDCQt2HnocVD_PIqnvov4KBa8Z_oevrmSLUxJ_z9-vFpMTjYV_C8t04wM184lk41pLtGr4_IHTFUs_rEM0LPZbdJQxgIyuJNKfig?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"]

notes.title: Wield the Sound: The Resonant Tones of Resonant Blade
notes.content:
The battlefield hums with power. Will you resonate or fall silent?

In Resonant Blade, sound isn’t just something you hear, it’s something you wield. At the heart of the game lies the Resonant Tones, a set of six unique frequencies that shape combat, puzzle-solving, and exploration.

Tune In, Strike Hard
Atlas begins with three Tones, with the other three earned by taking down dungeon bosses. Each vibrates at a unique frequency, from the deep pulse of Red to the sharp trill of Magenta. Enemies, structures, and the environment all resonate with these Tones. By tuning the Resonant Blade to match their frequency, Atlas can cut through defenses, trigger hidden mechanisms, and uncover secrets buried in the world.

But Resonance isn’t just about combat. Scattered across Terra are Resonant Orbs, ancient switches, and hidden pathways all waiting for the right frequency to bring them to life. To see and hear these vibrations, Atlas uses the Resonance Scanner, highlighting objects in range with a color-coded aura and an audible cue. Some puzzles even require listening carefully to catch the right tone.

Unleash Triads - Sonic Finishing Moves
Beyond matching tones, Atlas can harness their power through Triads, special abilities fueled by charged resonance energy. To activate a Triad, Atlas must gather three Charges—earned by parrying attacks or striking enemies with the right Tone. Different combinations trigger different attacks. For example, storing Red + Yellow + Blue unlocks Wave Blade, a cutting shockwave that rips through enemies. Each Triad has its own Resonance, so choosing the right one before attacking is key. With 12 Triads to unlock, six are tied to story progression, while the other six can be bought from Node47, a weapons engineer who deals in sound-based tech. In Resonant Blade, every fight is a song, every puzzle a harmony waiting to be struck. Tune in, match frequencies, and wield the power of sound itself.


WAVE BLADE [color=red]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
Launches a horizontal sonic wave that pierces through enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/9595fe3f1c2346af0cb1d8999652f0e27b2f9acf.gif

SONIC SLAM [color=orange]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
Slam the ground with a resonant shockwave, damaging and knocking back enemies in a wide radius.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/807bee76bb4cd269f63147695edc658c3420edcf.gif

TIME STRETCH [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
Generate a resonant field that slows enemies and projectiles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/01f066c03d5cbe1b83d8485633207348358a8eb6.gif

CYMATIC HEAL [color=red]◉[/color] [color=orange]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=lime]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=magenta]◉[/color] (3x any color)
Convert sound into vitality, restoring 25 HP.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/3bc6ccf2fe1e9872bd1c67cb74bf65f39e30026a.gif

More Resonant Combos Await
With 12 Triads in total, we’ve only scratched the surface. Will you discover the hidden combo that unleashes Echo Slice or the rare defensive power of Harmony Shield?
